kind: dated cloud CPU prototype and source optimization evidence; no live parallelism or hardware proof

workers.coordinator: additional main thread captures inputs and joins; only worker threads perform row preparation in parallel modes

units: ns for time columns, KiB for RSS columns
order: two baseline processes then two optimized processes; each process rotates serial/2/4 order between five rounds, second process reverses initial mode order
work_clock: capture owned draft plus borrow immutable owner-specific inputs, prepare every row, spawn/join/ordered collection and drop captured inputs; RSS/proof/fixture work excluded
proof: Every timed batch compares complete typed results against its serial reference and hashes ordered frame/recall/attention and literal perception/memory/cognitive words. All case input and output hashes match across four source/process groups. Bank/topology inputs stay unchanged.
memory_scope: RSS snapshots and cumulative process HWM include libraries, fixture/bucket storage, allocator history and retained serial reference outputs. These are not fresh per-mode peaks, allocation counts or live-game memory. Input JSON buffers are dropped before timing.
scheduling_scope: Empty usize-copy cohort capture/spawn/join/ordered collection, a separate comparison rather than measured full-preparation overhead; full scheduling work is included in main clocks.
validator_scope: One public validate_for_draft pass per fresh unbound pre-routing recall, wall time only. Do not double this into a predicted baseline+routed saving.
historical_build_note: Before manifest records the original unasserted builder SHA and rlib hashes as they existed at build time. Cargo subsequently overwrote same-named baseline rlibs. Preserved baseline executable hash and source/probe/helper identities were verified. Published checked builder adds replacement assertions and emits byte-identical generated Rust; its SHA is separately recorded.
